name: JavaScript
summary: Dynamically typed, prototype-based language with first-class functions, created for Netscape Navigator and standardized as ECMAScript (ECMA-262); it runs in every web browser and in server/embedded runtimes such as Node.js, Deno, Bun and QuickJS.

level_notes.0: There is no reference implementation; ECMA-262 is implemented independently by V8 (Chrome, Node.js), SpiderMonkey (Firefox), JavaScriptCore (Safari), QuickJS, Hermes and others. engine262 mirrors the specification text clause by clause, and test262 is the official conformance suite. SpiderMonkey links use the mozilla-firefox/firefox GitHub repository.
level_notes.1: ECMA-262 is published yearly by Ecma International (also adopted as ISO/IEC 16262); the living draft at tc39.es/ecma262 is the authoritative text between editions. Changes go through the staged TC39 proposal process. Host features (event loop, workers, DOM, Node.js modules) are specified outside ECMA-262.
level_notes.2: MDN is treated as secondary: it is the de-facto reference but is not normative.
